item.title: 76ers reportedly make NBA history with never before seen prediction market partnership
item.description: 76ers reportedly make NBA history with never before seen prediction market partnership originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Philadelphia 76ers signed LeBron James for just $8 million this summer, marking the largest pay cut in NBA history. Sure, James has made plenty of money throughout his career since joining the NBA, so the contract wasn't necessarily a big deal for him. However, James found another way to make money through endorsements and partnerships, including one with Polymarket. “LeBron James will make more money from his Polymarket partnership than from playing for the 76ers, Front Office Sports has learned. The prediction-market platform is paying James $15 million a year under the recently announced partnership, sources tell FOS. James is not an investor in Polymarket, just an endorser, one source says," Front Office Sports' Ryan Glasspiegel and Ben Horney wrote. James was smart to pursue this opportunity, as it gives him another source of income outside of his playing contract. However, NBA insider Brett Siegel revealed that this type of arrangement could become a trend for players signing smaller deals. “As far as my knowledge goes, this doesn't interfere with any CBA rules, but moving forward, these side deals players have with companies could directly lead to smaller contracts to help with cap relief, which in theory, is kind of like cap circumvention," Siegel wrote. On Friday, The Athletic's Mike Vorkunov revealed that the 76ers organization would be partnering with Kalshi, marking the first time an NBA team has made a prediction market platform its official partner. “The Philadelphia 76ers have struck a multi-year deal with Kalshi to make Kalshi its official prediction market partner. Sixers say they're the 1st NBA team to name an official prediction market partner, and are following in the footsteps of the NBA's deals this week,” Vorkunov wrote. The game is continuing to grow off the court, and deals like this were unheard of just a couple of seasons ago. It is certainly something new, but other teams will likely start pursuing similar partnerships. In a season where James could have set a trend with prediction markets, his team in Philadelphia may be doing the same. Perhaps James was the inspiration the 76ers needed to pursue this deal with Kalshi. item.title: Zverev thrashes GB's Fery to reach Vienna semis
item.description: Alexander Zverev won the French Open and US Open this year [Getty Images] Alexander Zverev marked his rise to world number one with a dominant victory over Britain's Arthur Fery to reach the semi-finals of the Vienna Open. The German top seed, who is set to replace Jannik Sinner at the summit of the men's rankings, needed just 58 minutes to secure a comprehensive 6-0 6-2 win. Fery did not look at his best throughout the encounter after receiving treatment on his leg near the end of his last-16 win over Lorenzo Musetti on Thursday. The match was a repeat of the pair's Wimbledon semi-final this summer, which Zverev won in straight sets to end Fery's remarkable run. "I think Arthur is a bit of a different opponent than I had yesterday. He doesn't have the same firepower, but he plays tactically extremely well," said Zverev. "I know the score was 6-0 6-2, but he should not put himself down too much. It is his first year on the Tour and he is doing amazing things." Like at Wimbledon, Fery upset the odds to reach the last eight in Vienna by beating former world number five Musetti, but the 24-year-old was outclassed by Zverev. Zverev dropped only six points on serve in the match, while bringing up nine break points against Fery, converting five of them. The German is aiming for his third title this year after winning the French Open and US Open. He has taken advantage of injuries to Carlos Alcaraz and Sinner this year to leapfrog them in the rankings, becoming the second German to reach the top of the men's game after Boris Becker in 1991. Zverev will face Australian fifth seed Alex de Minaur or Italy's Matteo Berrettini in the last four. In the other semi-final, Spanish second seed Alcaraz will face Russian third seed Daniil Medvedev. Seven-time Grand Slam-winner Alcaraz beat American seventh seed Tommy Paul 6-4 7-6 (7-2) in his quarter-final. Medvedev triumphed over France's Adrian Mannarino 6-2 6-3 in his last-eight tie - a victory which seals the 30-year-old's place in the season-ending ATP Finals. It will be Medvedev's seventh time appearing at the finals as he joins the already-qualified Zverev, Alcaraz and Ben Shelton. At the Pan Pacific Open in Tokyo, world number one Elena Rybakina withdrew from her quarter-final tie against Leylah Fernandez with a neck injury. Rybakina's withdrawal comes one day after she secured the year-end women's singles number one ranking . Fernandez, who received a walkover, will face Russia's Kamilla Rakhimova in the last-four. item.title: Coinbase (COIN) Misses Revenue Estimates as Users Fall, Armstrong Sets Up New Share Sales
item.description: Bitcoin Magazine Coinbase (COIN) Misses Revenue Estimates as Users Fall, Armstrong Sets Up New Share Sales Coinbase had a mixed third quarter. Revenue came in at $1.20 billion, below the $1.233 billion analysts expected, according to company filings. Subscription and services revenue did better, reaching $570 million. The company is still heavily tied to trading activity, but its recurring income is growing. Monthly Transacting Users fell to 7.4 million, down from 9.3 million a year earlier. During its earnings call, Coinbase blamed overall market conditions. Its share of crypto trading volume did rise to 10.7%, the fourth straight quarter of gains, which suggests it is winning business even as the broader market quiets. Adjusted EBITDA was $332.9 million, extending a run of 15 straight profitable quarters on that measure. The prediction markets business passed $200 million in annualized revenue, and Coinbase One hit a record number of subscribers. JUST IN: Coinbase disclosed buying 643 Bitcoin worth $1.5 billion for its balance sheet in Q3 pic.twitter.com/5BYdrwLCJN — Bitcoin Magazine (@BitcoinMagazine) October 30, 2026 Coinbase CEO preps share sales Separately, filings reported on October 30 show CEO Brian Armstrong has set up a plan to sell up to 8.17 million Class A shares. He adopted the plan in August under SEC Rule 10b5-1, which lets executives schedule sales ahead of time. Sales could run from November 16 through October 2027, subject to stock price conditions. Co-founder Fred Ehrsam and President Emilie Choi have similar plans, bringing the total to about 13.6 million shares. This is not new territory for Armstrong. In the past, VanEck analyst Matthew Sigel tracked about $545.7 million in sales over nine months, starting in April 2025. Armstrong has said these sales are part of his risk management, not a signal about the company. Coinbase stock slumps nearly 15% Coinbase shares (COIN) fell about 15% today, but not necessarily due to this earnings report. Binance disclosed a security breach on October 29 that it estimates at $6.3 billion, making it the largest crypto theft on record. Around $3 billion in assets has been frozen so far, with industry partners assisting in the freezes. The hackers are allegedly linked to North Korea, though Binance has not attributed the attack to any group. The exchange says it has found no evidence of a leaked wallet private key. Binance says it has $6.34 billion in reserves available to cover losses. Deposits were unaffected, and the company expects to resume withdrawals within 48 hours. Figures remain preliminary, and estimates vary slightly across outlets. The market reacted quickly. Bitcoin fell roughly 4.5% to below $77,000. Shares of Strategy (MSTR) fell nearly 10% on the day. Strive (ASST) shares fell over 12% at times. Coinbase’s stock is down over 55% on the year. This post Coinbase (COIN) Misses Revenue Estimates as Users Fall, Armstrong Sets Up New Share Sales first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine

item.title: Arsenal dealt multiple injury boosts ahead of Liverpool clash
item.description: Arsenal dealt multiple injury boosts ahead of Liverpool clash Arsenal Injury Update Before Liverpool Clash as Rice, Calafiori and Tzolis Return to Training Arsenal head to Anfield with a useful boost, even if the broader picture still carries a few complications. Ahead of the Premier League meeting with Liverpool, Mikel Arteta has confirmed that Declan Rice, Christos Tzolis and Riccardo Calafiori all returned to training on Friday. That matters, because Arsenal need a reaction and they need bodies. The timing is obvious. Arsenal are coming off an embarrassing Carabao Cup exit, dumped out by Fleetwood Town after a 1-1 draw and a 5-3 defeat on penalties. Aaron Loupalo-Bi scored before the break, Viktor Gyokeres levelled in the second half, and Jay Lynch did the rest with a string of saves. The result put Arsenal in the wrong kind of history, the first reigning Premier League champions to lose a League Cup tie against a fourth-tier side. Arsenal Injury Update Ahead of Anfield Still, league form has been solid. Arsenal sit second on 21 points, level with Manchester City and behind only on goal difference. They have conceded just five goals in eight league games, and the 2-0 win over Everton last weekend underlined that they remain organised, efficient and hard to break down. That is why the fitness update matters. Rice, Calafiori and Tzolis being back in training gives Arteta options in midfield, defence and attack. Noni Madueke remains uncertain and will be checked again after Saturday’s session. Photo: IMAGO Liverpool vs Arsenal Carries Weight for Both Sides Liverpool, now led by Andoni Iraola, are fourth on 15 points and already six behind Arsenal. At home, that gap is the story. Win, and the table tightens. Lose, and Arsenal gain control over a direct rival near the top end. There are still absentees for the visitors. Bukayo Saka is expected to miss at least six weeks with a quad injury suffered against Bayern Munich. William Saliba has not featured at all this season because of a long-term back issue. Max Dowman is also out after Arsenal failed in their appeal against his red card at Fleetwood, meaning a three-match suspension that also rules him out against Hull City and Newcastle United. Premier League Table Adds Edge at Anfield So Arsenal arrive stronger than they looked a few days ago, but not whole. That is usually enough to shape a big away game. At Anfield, availability often tells its own story.

item.title: Browns fans weigh in on last week’s offensive outburst, and is Cleveland the best team in the AFC?
item.description: The Browns had yet another game-winning drive against the Titans last week, their fifth to correspond with five victories — to improve to 5-2 on the season. Week-to-week, fan confidence increased by 3 percentage points up to 88%, a new season high again. If Cleveland can sweep the Steelers this week, that percentage might shoot up into the 90s. By comparison, 70% of Steelers fans are confident in the direction of their team. Browns fans: Make your pick in the SB Nation app! Take Reacts surveys, create Browns polls, and see how your answers compare with fellow Dawgs By Nature fans. Then discuss the results with the Dawg Pound. Download the SB Nation app on iOS or Android . Besides the confidence meter, the main question we asked this week was focused on what fans felt about the Browns’ offensive outburst last week. Was it a sign that they’ve turned the corner? A fluke? Overall, 51% said that the offense was nice, but attributed much of it to the Titans just sucking. 47% of fans think the offense had indeed turned a corner, while only 2% think it was just a fluke what happened last week. One fan thinks Todd Monken is opening up the offense, but needs to keep at it and break some more tendencies: I feel like Monken is opening up the offense. I think he was going tight too often. I love TIGHT formations, but with a young line and mediocre FB/blocking TEs, I question the fetish. I hope they just dont’ settle. mix it up. go tight every now and then. make the defense rotate their personnel, and just smash them when we have a mismatch. I just hate going TIGHT, after TIGHT, after TIGHT. the defense just gets bigger, bigger and bigger. I keep saying. the defense has the advantage, and if we’re predictable getting even 2 yards into their territory is tough. speed is key. SPREAD EM WIDE!! Corley and Wallace are said to be blocking well. let’s not be too predictable. they have speed too. get them out in space, especially when PIT (or anyone else) isn’t looking for it. 1 target for the whole year on 116 snaps. that’s just not right. Another fan thinks it’s really a combination of things coming together: I think it’s a combination of the Titans suck and we are finding a groove. The offense is going to to get better. You have a lot of young guys out there and a new O-line that is starting to play better together. There are going to be bumps in the road, but this team is improving. On a national scale, fans were asked who the best team in the AFC is, and the Browns actually received 5% of the vote. Don’t shoot the messenger. According to FanDuel , the Browns are 3.5 point underdogs against the Steelers this week, with the over/under being 39.5.

item.title: Alex Afari Jr. receives positive ruling in eligibility lawsuit
item.description: The NCAA’s fight to keep Kentucky linebacker Alex Afari Jr. and other athletes off the field took a hit Friday when Kentucky Court of Appeals Judge Sara Walter Combs denied the organization’s request for emergency relief. More than 30 athletes from the class of 2022 are named in the ongoing lawsuit, and they will continue to exhaust every option in pursuit of an additional year of eligibility in their respective sports. As things stand Friday afternoon, the athletes in the lawsuit, including Afari, are eligible to play. Does this mean it’s over and the litigation is finished? Not quite, but we may be nearing a final resolution. Eligibility could change again, because the next step is for a three-judge panel of the Kentucky Court of Appeals to consider the NCAA’s request for interlocutory relief. The athletes’ attorneys have until Nov. 6 to respond to that motion. The situation is one thing for basketball players still navigating the eligibility waters. For players like Afari, though, the college football season is winding down and time is running out. Thankfully, the Cincinnati native has seen the field in spurts this season despite the back-and-forth court rulings. Afari has played in six of UK’s eight games and recorded 11 total tackles, but he hasn’t had the chance to shine the way we’ve seen in previous seasons. For the Kentucky Football program, this has been no normal season by any stretch of the imagination. With all sights set on making and advancing in the College Football Playoff, having depth pieces like Alex Afari Jr. at your disposal will be huge for Will Stein and his staff. You also have to feel for him and the other athletes named in the lawsuit, as they want some finality in this situation as much as any of us do. It seems like that final decision may be coming sooner rather than later.

item.title: What Does Max Verstappen Make of a Le Mans Drive With Daniel Ricciardo?
item.description: Max Verstappen has responded to Daniel Ricciardo’s query about a potential Le Mans 24 Hours stint. In the build-up to the F1 Mexico GP weekend, the Beyond the Grid podcast featured Ricciardo in the hot seat for the first time, opening up about life after Formula 1 and the dreaded end in Singapore. It left him humiliated, and he explained why . The Australian certainly wants to return, but probably for a one-off race like the Le Mans 24 Hours rather than anything else, to find closure on his terms. He is not ready for anything full-time as he is already burned out from racing. But a one-off, sharing data and everything with a proper teammate, would perk him up. Who can be his teammates, though? Sergio Perez popped up as a popular pairing of Red Bull ’s Verstappen and Aston Martin’s Fernando Alonso, which Ricciardo is up for as well. Ricciardo Names His Potential Le Mans Teammates He does put Verstappen on his list and the second one could be Sebastian Vettel if he is up for it. “On the racing front, like, yeah, that’s something that a year ago, I would have said, ‘I will never put a helmet on again, I am done, that’s it,’” said Ricciardo. “But there’s something there; I am like, it’d be nice to also for me to, I guess, like, finish a racing career a bit more on my terms. “So, to do something, when I take the helmet off, I am smiling and happy, and maybe that’s the last bit of closure I need. I mean, the thought of doing a full championship or something just still doesn’t really sound that exciting. Probably a one-off, like a one-off Le Mans 24 Hours. “[With Max Verstappen and Fernando Alonso] that seems like a popular choice. I feel he doesn’t have to; I don’t want to put pressure on him, but no, obviously Max is the name that would be high on the list. Actually, him winning in car number three made me feel a certain way, in a good way. “I’ll say Max is one that could, yeah, we talked about Red Bull, obviously, in 2018 and what if. I was trying to get back to the team at the end of my career, so maybe that’s a way that we could, yeah, give the people what they want,” summed up Ricciardo, who had been teammates with Verstappen until the 2018 F1 season. Daniel Ricciardo speaks to Calum Nicholas on the Indeed Stage at Red Bull Race Nights in Austin, Texas, USA on October 23, 2026. // Angela Wang / Red Bull Content Pool // SI202610250667 // Usage for editorial use only // Verstappen Says Ricciardo is Smart to Choose Him But is Verstappen up for it? The Dutchman was asked about it during his media session at the F1 Mexico GP. The four-time champion joked about Ricciardo being a smart man to choose him. But he ruled himself out for the time being due to lack of time, with involvement in Formula 1 and also GT racing. “He’s a smart man to choose me in the car, but we have to see,” said Verstappen. “It just depends on a lot of things. Also, for me, like, if I want to do it, I want to do it properly with really good prep, and at the moment I cannot do that.

item.title: Kings rumors: Sacramento is most embarrassing team in NBA. Is Doug Christie on hot seat?
item.description: © Jayne Kamin-Oncea-USA TODAY Sports Kings rumors: Sacramento is most embarrassing team in NBA. Is Doug Christie on hot seat? appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Sacramento Kings have endured a disastrous start to the 2026-27 NBA season, dropping their first five games by an average margin of 16.6 points. However, head coach Doug Christie is reportedly not on the hot seat despite the team’s continued struggles. According to The Athletic’s Sam Amick, Sacramento’s front office believes Christie deserves a fair opportunity to prove himself with a healthier roster before evaluating his future with the organization. Amick reported that the Kings are prioritizing the development of Christie and their younger players rather than making an immediate coaching change. However, continued losses could eventually force the organization to reconsider its position. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Sacramento’s struggles reached another low Thursday night following a 132-120 loss to the previously winless New Orleans Pelicans . The defeat dropped the Kings to 0-5, with three of their losses coming by double digits. The Kings have also suffered blowout losses to the Los Angeles Clippers and San Antonio Spurs by 25 and 27 points, respectively. Kings’ injury concerns complicate Doug Christie’s future Sacramento has navigated significant injuries throughout the opening weeks of the season, with Ben Simmons, Keegan Murray, Maxime Raynaud and Dylan Cardwell all sidelined. Simmons will miss the entire 2026-27 season after suffering a torn right Achilles tendon, while Murray is dealing with left ankle capsulitis. Raynaud remains sidelined with a right patellar subluxation, and Cardwell is recovering from a left calf strain. Murray is expected to be reevaluated within 10 to 14 days, while Raynaud continues his rehabilitation and Cardwell is expected to undergo another evaluation. Despite the injuries, Sacramento has received encouraging production from rookie guard Darius Acuff Jr., who recorded 34 points, 14 assists and six rebounds against New Orleans. Acuff is averaging 24.0 points and 6.6 assists through five games, providing one of the few bright spots amid Sacramento’s winless start. Christie remains in the final guaranteed season of his contract, which includes a team option for the following campaign. His immediate future appears secure, but Sacramento’s continued struggles could increase pressure on the organization to make changes. The Kings will look for their first victory Saturday when they visit the undefeated Memphis Grizzlies (5-0) at 5 p.m. PT. Related: Kings star Ben Simmons’ ‘unicorn’ declaration sparks fan reactions all over the map Related: Kings’ Ben Simmons called out Steve Kerr during preseason after Warriors passed on him

item.title: UTSA Basketball Coach Who Passed Out in Car Moments Before DWI Arrest Suspended Ahead of Season Start
item.description: Austin Claunch Credit: Andrew Wevers/Getty NEED TO KNOW UTSA has suspended its basketball coach after he was arrested on suspicion of driving while intoxicated Austin Claunch was arrested in Corpus Christi, Texas on Tuesday, Oct. 27 University officials said they would determine the next steps of his suspension Just days before the season opener, the University of Texas at San Antonio (UTSA) has suspended basketball coach Austin Claunch following his arrest on suspicion of driving while intoxicated. Claunch, 36, was arrested in Corpus Christi just before 2 a.m. on Tuesday, Oct. 27 after police found that he performed poorly on sobriety tests, San Antonio ABC affiliate KSAT-TV reported . The coach was found passed out inside his running Mercedes, which was parked outside a gas station, according to the news station. Police noted his slurred speech and smelled alcohol on his breath, a report obtained by the outlet said. Claunch, who was identified as James Austin Claunch in the report, was taken to a hospital where his blood was drawn after he refused to take a breath test. Follow your favorite athletes on and off the field with PEOPLE’s free sports newsletter — sign up now! On Wednesday, the university announced that it had suspended the third-year coach and will determine the next steps after reviewing the circumstances of his arrest. Austin Claunch Credit: Jason Clark/Getty “UTSA Head Men’s Basketball Coach Austin Claunch has been suspended effective today following his arrest on suspicion of driving while intoxicated,” UTSA Athletics Director Lisa Campos said in a statement Wednesday night . “The university is reviewing the circumstances and will determine appropriate next steps, including the length of his suspension.” Claunch was the youngest head coach in Division I basketball from 2018 to 2021 after he took over at Nicholls State University. He was previously an assistant coach at George Mason, Clemson, and at Alabama under Nate Oats. In a statement, Claunch took responsibility for his actions. “I made a grave error in judgment, and I deeply regret my actions and the disappointment I have caused,” Claunch said. “I sincerely apologize to the young men I have the privilege of coaching, my fellow coaches and colleagues, President [Taylor] Eighmy, Dr. Lisa Campos and the entire Roadrunner community.” Assistant Nick Bowman will serve as acting coach when the Roadrunners open the season on Monday, Nov. 2 at San Jose State. Read the original article on People

item.title: No. 6 Utah vs. Cincinnati: How to watch, listen to or stream the game
item.description: Utah Utes wide receiver Ryan Davis (9) spins away from Cincinnati Bearcats safety Christian Harrison (5) as Utah and Cincinnati play at Rice Eccles Stadium in Salt Lake City on Saturday, Nov. 1, 2025. | Scott G Winterton, Deseret News No. 6 Utah (7-0, 4-0) at Cincinnati (5-2, 2-2) Kickoff: Saturday, 1:45 p.m. MDT Venue: Nippert Stadium TV: ESPN Livestream: ESPN app with participating TV provider Radio: ESPN 700 AM/92.1 FM /KZNS 1280 Series: Utah leads 1-0 Weather: Saturday’s Cincinnati forecast is high 60s through the entire game The trends For Utah: The Utes are the final Big 12 team that remains unbeaten. To achieve this status, Utah defeated previously No. 14-ranked Houston, the first opponent with a winning record the Utes have faced so far this season. The win vaulted Utah in the rankings as the team travels to Cincinnati. There is not a lot of history between the two schools, in fact, this is just the second meeting. The first meeting came in 2025 when Brendan Sorsby made the trip to Salt Lake City and left with a 45-14 thumping. For Cincinnati: Beginning the season 4-0, the Bearcats got to a strong start against weaker competition before experiencing a two-game losing streak at Arizona and West Virginia; however, Cincinnati bounced back in a big way with a win against then No. 8 Texas Tech and look to keep momentum rolling come Saturday. What to watch for This could be a tricky game for Utah as the team heads to the same venue another top-10 team traveled to and lost in the Bearcats’ game previous to this one. The Utes are coming off their biggest win so far in the season and will need to be prepared for a Cincinnati team that has a lot of momentum after a big win. The Bearcats are looking for a second straight top-10 victory on Saturday. For the Utes to return to Salt Lake City unscathed Devon Dampier (and whoever else is taking snaps) will need to take care of the football. Cincinnati turned the Red Raiders over twice along with a dominant 21-0 second quarter that ultimately led to their demise. After Utah’s game against Houston, it appears Utah has the defense to stop any offensive dominance from Cincinnati, but taking care of the football could be difficult. Throwing two interceptions against the Cougars, Dampier cannot get lackadaisical with the football or a Cincinnati home crowd could get rowdy and make things difficult. On the defensive side, the run game will be an area of focus for Morgan Scalley’s Utes. Cincinnati only had 172 yards passing in its rout of Texas Tech, but gained 255 yards on the ground against a talented Red Raiders defense. Running back Cole Tabb, coming off a 173-yard game, will be a player the Utes’ defensive game plan will take into account. And if Utah is able to create pressure on Bearcat quarterback JC French IV, the Utes could create some turnovers. Player to watch Utah Utes quarterback Devon Dampier (4) celebrates a huge run during a game against Houston at Rice-Eccles Stadium in Salt Lake City Saturday,

item.title: Jeffery Simmons is a ‘red-level’ defender that Super Bowl teams need
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS, INDIANA - OCTOBER 18: Jeffery Simmons #98 of the Tennessee Titans celebrates after recovering a fumble against the Indianapolis Colts during the third quarter of the game at Lucas Oil Stadium on October 18, 2026 in Indianapolis, Indiana. (Photo by Andy Lyons/Getty Images) | Getty Images What do Leonard Williams, Jalen Carter, Chris Jones, Fletcher Cox, and Aaron Donald all have in common? They’re all difference-making, All-Pro-level interior defenders who won Super Bowls. The Chicago Bears believe they just acquired one who can help them get there. At his press conference earlier today, Bears general manager Ryan Poles was asked what the trade for Jeffery Simmons means to him after a “five-year journey” to get the position right. “Yeah, you probably go all the way back to the first free agency when I took a shot there,” Poles said about his signing of Larry Ogunjobi, who failed his physical and had the contract rescinded. “I remember having conversations with you guys, and I hear it all the time; it’s like, ‘Does Poles see value in offensive linemen and defensive linemen?’ I’m well aware of the impact that those guys have on football teams,” he said. “If you do the research, you know, Super Bowl teams, really, probably you go back to 2018; since then, they all have what we call a red-level interior defensive lineman. So in order to get to there, you need one. I really believe that.” “So we’ve been searching, but the draft, again, when you go best available, sometimes the draft doesn’t provide that to you. Sometimes I know free agency really doesn’t do that at that level. It’s very hard for guys to get out of the building when they have all of those things that we’re talking about. So, we’ve been searching.” The 29-year-old Simmons has 4 Pro Bowl nods and has been named to 3 All-Pro Teams. “It was an opportunity that we had to jump on,” Poles said af the chance to trade for Simmons. “I’ve talked to you guys before in a lot of different situations. We’re going to stay opportunistic. We’re going to stay flexible. If something presents itself, we’ll see how does this fit, and this is one that we felt like we could make work. And again, it’s going to help us short-term and long-term.” Simmons is at practice today, and he’s scheduled to meet the media after. Getting right to work 💪 pic.twitter.com/iuu9xTjHS9 — Chicago Bears (@ChicagoBears) October 30, 2026 Poles said it was up to the coaches if Simmons will play this week. The Bears will have one more regular practice tomorrow and have a walk-through before playing the Seattle Seahawks on Monday night. Defensive coordinator Dennis Allen held a pre-practice presser and said , “The more he (Simmons) can digest, the more opportunities there will be for him on the field. This will be a work in progress.” My guess is he’ll make his Chicago Bears debut under the lights in Seattle.

item.title: Real Madrid ‘very close’ to Latif Ismann signing
item.description: Real Madrid ‘very close’ to Latif Ismann signing La Liga giants Real Madrid are closing on an imminent deal to add to the club’s midfield ranks at academy level. This comes amid confirmation of Los Blancos being all set to land Latif Ismann. Ismann, for his part, is a 19-year-old midfielder who generally operates in a box-to-box ‘8’ role. The Ghanaian has long been held in high regard in Spain, hailed for his ability to get around the pitch, as well as his technical qualities. Ismann is currently plying his trade with Logroñés, but soon looks set to be afforded a chance to prove his talents at one of European football’s leading clubs. As per a report from ESPN : ‘Real Madrid are very close to signing Latif Issman, a young midfielder from UD Logroñés, for their youth academy.’ Los Blancos also expressed a keen interest in Issman’s services this past summer, but finally look set to land their man with a view to the 2027/28 campaign. Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: United Athletic Conference men’s hoops preview
item.description: United Athletic Conference Teams are in order of preseason ranking on KenPom Central Arkansas John Shulman returns several key pieces from last year’s breakthrough second season at the helm. That starts with Ty Robinson, a two-way scoring guard who is among the favorites for UAC Player of the Year. Luke Moore pairs with him in the backcourt as a two-way playmaker, while Malachiah Marable gives physicality down low. The swing piece for the Bears is Tucker Anderson, who was a star freshman for UCA a few years back, but never caught on at Utah State. He’s a 6-foot-10 sniper. Abilene Christian Abilene Christian brings back defensive-minded combo guard Yaniel Rivera, as well as 7-footer Cade Hornecker, who led the WAC in defensive rebounding rate last year. The most proven transfer is former Utah Tech big wing Noah Bolanga, a 6-foot-8 do-it-all forward. There’s a role here for New Mexico transfer Timeo Pons, who could be a big breakout piece. ACU needs to find contributions from freshmen and international recruits as well, though. This ranking feels a little high to me. Austin Peay Zyree Collins and Rashaud Marshall are an elite returning duo. Collins was incredibly impressive as a freshman last year, and Marshall was a beast on the inside. Loyola Chicago transfer Chuck Love will bring some skilled size at 6-foot-7. The Govs also have a talented incoming class, led by 6-foot-5 three-star wing Bradley Floyd, Michigan Gatorade Player of the Year Cam Ryans, and 6-foot-7 jumbo creator Felipe Minzer. A lot of responsibility will fall on freshmen for this group, but the team is talented enough – and has the bookends – to be right there for a league title. Little Rock Travis Ford has a really talented group in year one at Little Rock. Aaron Clark (Pepperdine) and Jah’Likai King (UMBC) were 14-plus-point-per-game scorers in Division I, while JUCO recruits Tyrese Lacey and Jalen Lyn will provide playmaking and scoring next to them. Terrion Burgess returns, but he’s overshadowed by five-in-five pickup Bradyn Hubbard, a two-way stud at Abilene Christian last year. The Trojans should be a contender for the UAC title. Tarleton State New head coach Eric Haut looks to bring stability to the Texans program after the Billy Gillespie roller-coaster tenure. UTEP transfer Caleb Blackwell will run the point, while Leroy Kelly IV appears to have taken a sophomore leap based on a few strong exhibition outings. Keep an eye on Virginia Tech transfer Brett Freeman as well, who has impressed in exhibitions. UT Arlington UT Arlington’s backcourt has a chance to be really fun. Tristan Hankins was a JUCO All-American and will run the offense, while Mier Panoam was an effective paint touch guard at North Dakota before transferring to Xavier. Pairing those guys with a high-upside frontcourt featuring two former high-major guys in Miles Goodman (who needs to take a major step-up this year) and Niko Bundalo could be fascinating. item.title: Rusev Denies Rumor About Joining New WWE Faction: 4 Alternative Ideas For His Return
item.description: WWE Rusev is healthy and ready to return to WWE television, but he is not on board with a rumor about his future. Speaking on TMZ’s Inside the Ring, Rusev was asked about a report that WWE plans to put him in a stable with Ethan Page and Big Cass . He said nobody in WWE has told him about it, and he is not sure he would want it. “It’s very internet booking. We have one, two, three bad guys, let’s put them together. I have not heard anything about this, but also, I don’t know if I’m okay with that either,” Rusev said. “Like, that guy, I left for a couple of months. I got hurt, sickness, and all that. So Page just went out there and found another tall guy to back him up. Like, ‘F you, bro. You never called me, checked on me. You’re just gonna go and find yourself a big guy? Good for you. I don’t wanna be associated with that.'” Rusev did leave room for the report to have been true at some point. “Also, because someone said that they could have been greenlit on Tuesday, but by the time Wednesday night comes, everything could be scrapped. Everything is changing by the hour and day,” he said. Before his absence, Rusev had been teaming with Page on Raw, and he took part in the number one contender’s gauntlet for the Intercontinental Championship in July. With Rusev pushing back on the faction idea, here are four other directions WWE could take with him. Feud With Ethan Page Rusev’s own comments set this one up. Page moved on to Big Cass while Rusev was out, and Rusev, even while joking about it, made it clear he did not appreciate it. Turning that into a story on television would give Rusev a personal feud as soon as he returns. It would also give WWE a way to turn Rusev into a babyface. He was one of the most popular acts in the company during the “Rusev Day” run in 2017 and 2018, and fans would likely get behind him against a smug Page and his new muscle. Chase the Intercontinental Championship Chad Gable has held the Intercontinental Championship since beating Penta at SummerSlam in August, and he has made several successful defenses on Raw. Page has also been involved in that title picture, standing over Gable with the belt on the October 19 episode of Raw. Rusev was in the gauntlet that decided Gable’s title shot, but he has not had a singles shot at the belt himself. A Rusev vs. Gable program would put two strong wrestlers together in very different styles. Gable has been beating smaller, faster opponents, and Rusev would give him a different kind of size and power challenge. Move to SmackDown for a US Title Run Rusev is a former three-time United States Champion, and the title is currently held by Trick Williams. A move to SmackDown would give him a fresh set of opponents and a clear goal. Rusev vs. Williams would be a physical heavyweight match, and it would let WWE present Rusev as a top midcard star again instead of a piece of a group. item.title: Rangers captain plays Tinker Bell at Halloween party: ‘makes group closer’
item.description: At 6-foot-1, nearly 220 pounds, and with a smile that features some chipped chicklets, J.T. Miller is not soon to be confused with Tinker Bell. But indeed, the New York Rangers captain rose to the occasion at the players’ annual Halloween party earlier in the week dressed as the famed Disney character. “It was a lot of fun,” Miller said Friday after the Rangers returned to practice following two days away from the rink. “My wife picks out partner costumes where I’m the woman and she’s the guy … and this year I was Tinker Bell and she was Peter Pan. “I’m sure there are [pictures]. I didn’t take any, but I’m sure there are some out there.” Miller probably does his fair share of dressing up at home, where he and his wife Natalie are raising two daughters — eight-year-old Scotlyn and seven-year-old Scarlett — and son Owen, who is four. But the 33-year-old had no hesitation being the belle of the ball Tuesday when the Rangers gathered with their families for a fun night amidst a busy first month of the 2026-27 NHL season. “I just think it makes the group closer,” Miller said about the team get together. Following their 6-3 loss to the Los Angeles Kings on Monday, the Rangers were one of only two teams to have played 14 games already this season. And it appeared to be catching up with them, since they hit a five-day break in the schedule on a three-game losing streak and just 1-4-1 in their past six. “I think this was a great time to have [a get together], plenty of time between games, some days off in there,” Miller explained. “A little, down, I would say, with our record the last couple of weeks, so I think it was good to have a little fun and get away from it, re-energize, and it makes you excited to come to work on days like today. We all had a lot of fun as group with the wives and girlfriends. It was a great time.” Defenseman Sean Durzi was impressed with the creative costumes on display at the party, including one couple who came dressed as the Statue of Liberty and a tourist. But which Rangers player had the best costume? “I think Scotty Morrow won,” Miller offered. “His was really good. I don’t want to say what he was, but he did great.” The Rangers practice again Saturday and then are back in game action Sunday, when they host the Edmonton Oilers at Madison Square Garden. item.title: Real Madrid close in on the signing of 19-year-old Ghanaian talent for Castilla
item.description: Real Madrid close in on the signing of 19-year-old Ghanaian talent for Castilla As reported by journalist Rodra of ESPN , Real Madrid are closing in on a deal to sign Ghanaian midfielder Latif Issman from UD Logrones, for the club’s reserve team RM Castilla. The 19-year-old starlet has been on the club’s radar for some time now, and negotiations are now gathering pace ahead of a potential transfer next season. Real Madrid step up efforts to sign Latif Issman Real Madrid held an interest in signing Issman last summer as well and made efforts to rope him in from Logrones to strengthen their Castilla squad. The move could not be completed in time, but Los Blancos have continued to work on the deal for the 19-year-old midfield starlet. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Rising Football Pros (@risingfootballpros_gh) Although a full and final agreement has not been reached and signed yet, negotiations between the two clubs are understood to be at a very advanced stage. As such, if everything proceeds according to plan, Issman appears all set to become Castilla’s first signing for the 2027/28 season. The report states that the teenage midfielder has a release clause worth €300,000 in his contract with Logrones, although it is unclear if Real Madrid will be paying the full amount or settling on a reduced fee. A part of a larger strategy The Real Madrid academy has become a significant source of transfer revenue for the club, with players developed at the club generating huge revenue through sales. Last summer alone, transfers involving La Fabrica graduates brought in more than €200 million for Real Madrid, covering for a large portion of their summer spending. Real Madrid signed Sergio Martinez last summer. (Photo courtesy: Real Madrid official website) The Merengues , therefore, remain on the lookout for exciting young talents to bring to the club’s youth and reserve team setups, where they help them develop and raise their market values before potentially selling them on for a bigger fee. The strategy saw Real Madrid saw promising talents like Sergio Martinez, Oscar Naasei, and Rayan Zinebi for the Castilla squad last summer. And now, Latif Issman’s acquisition for next summer seems set to continue the trend. A young midfielder with strong physicality and ability to cover ground, he will become Castilla’s first signing for 2027/28.

item.title: Far from home, Mexican star Canelo Álvarez pushes to reclaim his title
item.description: Canelo Álvarez walks to the ring before facing Terence Crawford at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas on Sept. 13, 2025. (Sarah Stier / Getty Images for Netflix) In the Middle East, Saúl “Canelo” Álvarez will return to the ring after a 13-month hiatus in search of more titles. In Riyadh, many time zones from his native Mexico and second home base in Las Vegas, Álvarez he try to take the World Boxing Council super-middleweight title from Christian Mbilli, an undefeated champion who has never faced an opponent of Álvarez’s caliber. The Guadalajara-born boxer arrived in Saudi Arabia on Monday, where he was greeted by Faisal Bafarat, CEO of the General Entertainment Authority (GEA). The event has faced unusual complications, with one of the fights on the card canceled because of security concerns raised by one of the boxers and criticism from figures in the boxing world who question the athletes’ safety — especially after several sporting events, including Formula 1, WTA and WWE events have been canceled or relocated because of the war in the Middle East. The fight between Canelo (63-3-2, 39 KOs) and Mbili (29-0-1, 24 KOs) headlines the “Mexico vs. The World” event at The Venue as part of the seventh edition of Riyadh Season. The bout will be broadcast on pay-per-view via DAZN (10 a.m. Pacific Time, main event around 1:10 p.m.). Terence Crawford throws a left punch at Canelo Álvarez at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas on Sept. 13, 2025. (Sarah Stier / Getty Images for Netflix) After a period of inactivity that included elbow surgery , Álvarez — beyond his opponents — faces his greatest enemy in Father Time, as demonstrated by his September 2025 loss to Terence Crawford , which cost him his four super-middleweight titles. Crawford retired after that victory — the best of his career — and Mbili went from interim champion to full WBC champion. After that painful defeat, Álvarez acknowledged that his mind wasn’t on the fight that night. “When you lose, you always review your mistakes, and at this level there’s very little difference between winning and losing,” said Álvarez, whose training concluded in Spain, where he shared a gym with heavyweight champion Oleksandr Usyk. “I did a good job preparing for that fight, but during fight week, my mind wasn’t in it.” For this bout, Álvarez chose to finish his preparation in Spain to avoid the adjustment issues he said he experienced during last year’s fight against William Scull, also in Riyadh. Álvarez hasn’t knocked out an opponent since defeating Caleb Plant by technical knockout in 2021, and the last opponent he clearly knocked out was Sergey Kovalev in 2019. Although he has defeated several high-caliber opponents who were physically larger than him, he has been unable to secure a knockout, which has fueled speculation that his power and stamina have declined over the years. If he loses, it would mark the first two consecutive losses of his career, and criticism regarding his decline would intensify. However, Álv

item.title: A.J. Brown Injury Report Sparks “Washed” Talk From Fans
item.description: David Butler II-Imagn Images Fans are calling A.J. Brown “washed” after he missed another practice session. Yahoo Sports reported the wide receiver was added to the injury report on Wednesday with a knee ailment. He sat out Thursday’s practice with the New England Patriots. This is not the first time his health has been a major worry this season. Brown has missed four games already due to injury. He was activated on Oct. 17 and played in the last two contests. But his production remains low. With only three games played, the receiver who has made the Pro Bowl three times secured nine receptions totaling 101 yards without scoring a touchdown. The high ankle sprain he suffered in the season opener against the Seattle Seahawks cost him a month of football. A knee issue has raised concern for the team. Fans Call Him “Made of Glass” People are saying the trade from Philadelphia was a mistake. According to Yahoo Sports, New England acquired him from the Eagles in exchange for a fifth-round pick in 2027 and a first-round pick in 2028. That deal looked like a win for the Patriots on paper. Now, the physical toll seems to be catching up to him. Some fans are even claiming “He Is Made of Glass,” according to the headlines surfacing on Yahoo Sports. Some observers are questioning the player’s value. The phrase “Eagles Fleeced Patriots” is trending online. It suggests New England got the short end of the stick. The team expected a star who could carry the offense. Instead, they have a player who cannot stay on the field. Nine catches in three games is not enough to justify a first-round pick in the trade. Coach Downing Still Has Faith Despite the noise, the coaching staff is trying to stay calm. WR coach Todd Downing spoke to the media on Thursday. He said he still has faith in the wide receiver. Downing acknowledged the disappointing performance but refused to give up on Brown. The team needs him to step up before they face the Miami Dolphins. The next game is set for Sunday, 4:25 PM ET, at Hard Rock Stadium. They need a win after losing to the Chicago Bears last week. The final score was 30-24, which ended a three-game winning streak. The Patriots cannot afford another loss with their playoff hopes fading. If Brown stays healthy, they might have a chance. If he is truly “washed,” the season could be over before November ends.

item.title: Pep who? Maresca claims reborn City are ahead of schedule after summer upheaval
item.description: FBL-EUR-C1-MANCHESTER CITY-TRAINING - AFP Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca believes the club is ahead of schedule following major summer changes after Pep Guardiola's decade of dominance. Maresca expressed satisfaction as City sit top of the Premier League despite significant squad changes. Maresca leads Manchester City transition smoothly Manchester City sit top of the Premier League table after eight matches under new manager Enzo Maresca. The Italian took charge following a trophy-laden decade under Pep Guardiola, navigating major squad departures including Bernardo Silva, John Stones, and Rodri. City remain active on all fronts, reaching the quarter-finals of the Carabao Cup and securing two wins from three Champions League ties. Maresca believes the club's rebuild is progressing faster than initially anticipated. Maresca insists City are competing ahead of schedule Speaking ahead of Saturday's fixture against Brighton, Maresca highlighted the speed of the team's adaptation. "I think we’re going in the right direction," Maresca affirmed. "I said in the last press conference, after so many years to change manager and many players it takes time to compete again and in this moment we are competing." "We changed many players and the manager but good thing about the club is we are competing in all the competitions and we know it takes time when you make this many changes but in this moment, we continue in the same way," he added. Manager embraces Premier League unpredictability Maresca acknowledged that competitive parity across the English top flight makes maintaining consistency a constant challenge. The manager pointed to teams like Aston Villa, Newcastle, and third-placed Brighton as proof of the league's rising standards. "Every season you can have one or two surprises that they are there and now the level is so similar that you can drop points against any team and win against any team," Maresca noted. City aim to solidify summit position Manchester City prepare to host high-flying Brighton at the Etihad Stadium in Saturday's 15:00 UK kick-off. Maresca's side look to secure three points before turning attention to European duties against RB Leipzig. City continue their campaign aiming to preserve momentum across all competitions.

item.title: Patriots’ Mike Vrabel short with media regarding A.J. Brown’s knee injury concerns
item.description: Credit: Joe Nicholson-Imagn Images Patriots’ Mike Vrabel short with media regarding A.J. Brown’s knee injury concerns appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . With the New England Patriots taking on the Miami Dolphins in Week 8 on Sunday, the status of star wide receiver A.J. Brown is up in the air ahead of the game. As fans are looking for an update on Brown ahead of the Patriots’ game against the Dolphins , head coach Mike Vrabel would speak on the matter, though briefly. According to Mike Giaradi of The Boston Sports Journal, he noted that Vrabel’s press conference on Friday was “short” and was not “keen to talk” about the injury to Brown. When asked whether Brown was rushed back to play after missing a chunk of the start of the season, he believes “those are separate issues.” If there was one thing that Vrabel said about Brown’s status for Sunday against Miami, it’s that he’s “questionable,” via Field Yates. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “No sign” of A.J. Brown during Patriots practice on Friday Patriots reporter Mike Reiss at ESPN would note that there was “no sign” of Brown on Friday during the media-access portion of practice. With Brown dealing with knee and ankle injuries, offensive coordinator Josh McDaniels spoke about the health of the receiver and needing the offense to be better. “He’s played eight quarters in almost two months and had four practices, I think. I’m certainly in the mode of ‘this is a process of building into our best football.’ We’ve seen that with pretty much every player that’s come here,” McDaniels said, via ESPN. “There’s things we can work on to do better, and certainly his health is going to be a big part of that,” McDaniels continued. “So, they tell us he can do A, B, and C; we’ll do A, B, and C. If there’s some element of things we need to wait on, we’ll do it. I love his attitude and approach; he’s been here working his tail off to try to put himself in a great position to help our team.” So far this season, Brown has recorded nine catches for 101 yards in three games, as it remains to be seen what his status looks like for Sunday against Miami. item.title: How to open the Crimson Manor in Phantom Blade Zero
item.description: The Crimson Manor is a mysterious location in Phantom Blade Zero that you discover after riding a suspicious elevator in the Weeping Creek Valley . item.title: Christian Pulisic reaches AC Milan contract decision after return to form under Ruben Amorim
item.description: Christian Pulisic has signed a contract extension with AC Milan -Credit:Image Photo Agency/Getty Images U.S. Men’s National Team attacker Christian Pulisic has opted to extend his stay in Serie A, signing a contract extension with AC Milan through the summer of 2031. The 28-year-old Pennsylvanian’s prior deal was set to expire after the ongoing season, with speculation having been rife of late regarding potential options for his future. However, Pulisic clearly has faith that the Rossoneri is on course to bounce back after an underwhelming couple of seasons, with ex-Manchester United boss Ruben Amorim now at the helm. “Since joining the Rossoneri in July 2023, Christian has established himself as a key member of the team, standing out for his technical ability, character, consistency and unwavering work ethic,” Milan said in a press release. “His 44 goals in 141 appearances for the Rossoneri highlight both his importance to the team and his role in the Club's future plans. Thierry Henry addresses Ballon d'Or criticism after Lamine Yamal and Kate Scott remarks Wayne Rooney launches into furious foul-mouthed rant at Manchester United players Pulisic has scored twice this season under Ruben Amorim -Credit:Image Photo Agency/Getty Images “Pulisic's contract extension reflects a shared commitment to building on the progress made together in recent years, with the ambition to keep improving, achieve new milestones and write more memorable chapters in the Club's history.” The American joined after four seasons in the Premier League with Chelsea, where he clinched the UEFA Champions League, Super Cup, and FIFA Club World Cup, although on a personal level, he struggled to consistently perform. A $24.4 million move to Milan followed in the summer of 2023, after which he rediscovered the outstanding form displayed during his time with Borussia Dortmund, scoring 15 goals in his debut season before leading the team with 17 the year after. However, after an excellent first half of the 2025/2026 season under newly appointed head coach Massimiliano Allegri, Pulisic and the team’s form nosedived after the new year, failing to find the back of the net for the rest of the season. An underwhelming FIFA World Cup campaign on home soil followed, ending the tournament with a bone bruise and a microfracture in his lower leg during the USMNT’s Round of 16 loss to Belgium. To listen to the latest episode of 'All Out Soccer' - CLICK HERE Having sat out preseason and the start to the current campaign as he rehabbed his injuries, Pulisic has since returned to the fold under Amorim, scoring his first two goals of 2026 in wins over Lecce and Udinese. “I'm really proud to have re-signed here in Milan because I'm really just in love with this team, this club,” he told club media. “Everything about it. The feeling that I got, the support from the fans through all of the good and bad times. But I knew immediately that this was the place for me.” Pulisic went on to add that “Milan

item.title: William Contreras declares himself the “Best catcher in the world” after Brewers’ World Series win
item.description: William Contreras earned World Series MVP honors after delivering an outstanding performance in the Milwaukee Brewers’ five-game triumph over the Tampa Bay Rays. He capped off his impressive series with an RBI double in the decisive Game 5, finishing the matchup with eight hits and four RBIs across five games. Just days after capturing the World Series championship and MVP honors, Contreras added another distinction to his growing list of accolades, this time earning recognition in a more lighthearted and modest fashion. “I don’t want to offend any of the other catchers in the league,” Contreras remarked via an interpreter. “The last thing I want to do is offend any of them, But sitting up here today, champion of the world, I feel like I’m the best catcher in the league. Again, that’s no disrespect to any of them. That’s the last thing I want to do. But today I feel like I’m the best catcher in the world.” William Contreras’ MVP run with the Brewers Oct 28, 2026; St. Petersburg, Florida, USA; Milwaukee Brewers catcher William Contreras (24) raises the World Series MVP trophy after defeating the Rays in game five of the 2026 World Series at Tropicana Field. Mandatory Credit: Jonathan Dyer-Imagn Images Contreras’ playoff run has given him a strong argument for being considered baseball’s best catcher. He made a major impact at the plate, batting .373 with three home runs and nine RBIs throughout the postseason. His contributions were especially noticeable in the World Series, where he recorded multiple hits in three consecutive games to help Milwaukee take a 3-0 series advantage. He was just as effective behind the plate, throwing out four baserunners and winning 10-of-13 ABS challenges while showcasing his pitch-framing skills. Oct 28, 2026; St. Petersburg, Florida, USA; Milwaukee Brewers manager Pat Murphy (00) and catcher William Contreras (24) celebrate defeating the Rays in game five of the 2026 World Series at Tropicana Field. Mandatory Credit: Kim Klement Neitzel-Imagn Images Few catchers can match the impact Contreras made on both offense and defense throughout the postseason. His role in bringing a championship to Milwaukee only strengthens his case as one of the game’s premier players at the position. After a performance like that, anyone looking to challenge his claim as baseball’s top catcher will have a high bar to clear. item.title: Fantasy Football Rankings: Players Hayden Winks is higher and lower on than consensus for Week 8
item.description: Fantasy football analyst Hayden Winks shares the players he's higher — and lower — on than Yahoo consensus for Week 8. These rankings will be tinkered with all the way until kickoff, so please check back in on our weekly rankings pages and Sunday AM sit/start show for the absolute latest. These blurbs are also in The Blueprint, which is my weekly rankings and analysis column. The RB version is out on Wednesdays, while t he WR version and the QB/TE/K/DEF version are each out on Thursdays before Thursday Night Football. Players Hayden is higher on Brenton Strange, TE, Jaguars - 39.5 proj. yards AVG Yahoo vs. Winks Lowest Yahoo Rank Hayden's Rank Difference +2.4 15 9 6 Strange has carved out consistent volume recently, commanding at least seven targets in three straight outings. Across his last four games, he sits as the TE12 on TE9 usage, averaging 8.7 half PPR points, 8.7 expected points per contest, and a 22% target share. In an offense this good, that means Strange is more of a low-end TE1 than a TE2. Indianapolis ranks 13th in half PPR points allowed to TEs at 11.3 points per game. The Colts have shown vulnerability to the position recently, giving up 19.0 half PPR points to Pat Freiermuth in Week 5 and 11.5 points to T.J. Hockenson in Week 7. Their LB room has been terrible, and they just traded away their best player in DeForest Buckner. Jacksonville hosts this divisional clash as 7.5-point home favorites with a healthy implied team total of 28.0 points (fourth). Bucky Irving, RB, Buccaneers - 89.5 proj. total yards AVG Yahoo vs. Winks Lowest Yahoo Rank Hayden's Rank Difference +1.4 14 10 4 Wow. The Bucs ran all over a sorry Panthers defense. Their OL was dominant, and Irving made the most of it. He handled a season-high 24 carries for 106 rushing yards and two touchdowns, leading to an RB2 finish on RB4 usage. Because everything worked, Kenny Gainwell and Sean Tucker got home in Baker Mayfield's return. This offense should be balanced while Mayfield's thumb heals, and Irving is in line for upside RB2 value. He's the RB14 on RB13 usage this season despite a month of problems at QB. Before an expected lockout takes hold on Dec. 1, many teams are expected to be aggressive in the early days of free agency, including New York. With an obvious need in the starting rotation, the player they are expected to make a serious push for is the two-time Cy Young winner. However, it might take a record-shattering deal worth around a half billion to secure his services. It is a price range Mets owner Steve Cohen may pass on since he already has so much invested in other players on the roster. Well, a worthwhile alternative that could come at a better price just became available. item.title: 'Five churches set on fire by Muslims?' Fake news by Islamophobic social media accounts
item.description: Several social media accounts associated with sharing anti-immigrant views claim French Muslims were responsible for burning five churches on October 17 – the day the nation was rocked by en masse protests. But both this number and story are fictitious. The French government agency that monitors religious heritage sites confirmed only one fire in a church occured in recent days; its cause unknown.

item.title: "I Heard the Jokes": Dwyane Wade Reacts to Miami Heat Changing His Statue After Years of Ridicule
item.description: October 27, 2024, Miami, USA: A close up of the newly unveiled Dwyane Wade in front of Kaseya Center on Sunday, Oct. 27, 2024, in Miami. Miami USA – ZUMAm67_ 0776213368st Copyright: xD.A.xVarelax ©IMAGO/ZUMA Press Wire Dwyane Wade has explained why he agreed to change the head of his Miami Heat statue after its original unveiling drew criticism over its likeness. The three-time NBA champion initially felt protective of the sculpture because of his involvement in its creation. However, he eventually reconsidered after recognizing what the tribute meant to the people of Miami. Miami Herald reporter Anthony Chiang shared Wade’s explanation for approving the changes in a post on X , quoting the former Heat star: “This isn’t about erasing the work that was already done or disrespecting the artists who put their time and talent into creating it. It’s about being willing to listen.” Wade acknowledged that the criticism started almost immediately after the statue was unveiled. “When my statue was unveiled in Miami, it didn’t take long for the conversation to become about one thing: the face.” He added, “I heard the jokes. I saw the memes. I read the reactions. Everybody had an opinion about whether it actually looked like me.” Wade's candid take on the Heat's statue redesign reveals what really bothered him about the original. Subscribe for the full story behind Miami's iconic correction. Although the reactions were difficult to ignore, Wade initially felt protective of the sculpture because he understood the effort behind it. “At first, it was hard not to feel protective of it because I had spent so much time involved in the process. I knew the work, care, and intention that had gone into creating the entire statue, and because of that, I felt a real connection to it.” The statue commemorates one of the defining moments of Wade’s career: his game-winner against the Chicago Bulls on March 9, 2009. After hitting the shot in double overtime, he jumped onto the scorer’s table and celebrated with the words that became closely associated with his time in Miami. Wade explained the personal significance of the celebration in his essay. “The statue captures one of the most meaningful individual moments of my career: the game-winner against Chicago and the birth of ‘This Is My House.’” He continued, “Outside of winning championships, it may be my favorite moment I ever had on a basketball court. There was something poetic about being a kid from Chicago, playing against Chicago, hitting that shot in the fashion that I did, and then jumping on the scorer’s table in Miami.” Wade also explained how the phrase came naturally from the emotion of the occasion. “”This Is My House” wasn’t planned. It came out of the emotion of everything that had just happened-the steal, the shot, the buzzer, the crowd, and the feeling of being home. Over time, those four words became bigger than one basketball game. They became part of the relationship between me and Miami.” That connect

item.title: ‘Definitely Was Unusual’ — NFL Analyst Questions Josh Jacobs’ ‘Awareness’ After Packers RB Faces Backlash for Controversial TD Celebration
item.description: ‘Definitely Was Unusual’ — NFL Analyst Questions Josh Jacobs’ ‘Awareness’ After Packers RB Faces Backlash for Controversial TD Celebration Josh Jacobs probably did not expect a touchdown celebration to become a bigger talking point than his performance against Carolina. The Green Bay Packers running back says the gesture had a personal meaning and was planned with a teammate before the game. But the brief clip that viewers saw told a different story to many fans, especially given Jacobs’ recent legal troubles. Now, analyst Mike Florio has questioned whether Jacobs should have anticipated that reaction. Mike Florio Questions Josh Jacobs’ Awareness After Controversial Celebration Jacobs said his celebration was part of a two-touchdown routine he had planned with wide receiver Savion Williams. The first part came during Green Bay’s previous game against Detroit, when Jacobs knelt to thank God after scoring. The next touchdown was supposed to reference the gospel song “Break Every Chain.” However, the broadcast showed only a brief moment of Jacobs standing with his hands behind his back. Given his recent return from a six-game stint on the NFL commissioner’s exempt list following an offseason domestic altercation, viewers interpreted the gesture as a reference to being handcuffed. BE THE GM OF YOUR FAVORITE TEAM: PFN’s Free NFL Mock Draft Simulator Jacobs disputed that interpretation after the Packers’ 27-19 victory over the Panthers. “They didn’t even get the whole celebration,” Jacobs said. “Basically, last week, we said the first celebration, when I score, I was going to thank God — that’s what I did last week.” He explained that the second part of the routine was planned around the gospel song and was supposed to include Williams pretending to unlock imaginary chains around his wrists. “The second one was going to be ‘Break Every Chain.’ It’s a gospel song. That was going to be the next celebration,” Jacobs added. The running back also expressed frustration with how the incomplete footage shaped the discussion around his actions. “It’s just a correlation, but like I said, the media [is] going to run with it. They’re going to make it something that it wasn’t, but it is what it is,” he said. Florio was not convinced that the explanation settled the issue. Speaking on “PFT Live,” the analyst questioned why Jacobs chose a gesture that could easily remind viewers of his recent legal troubles. item.description: ‘Has Totally Lost It,’ ‘Emotional, Non-Fact-Based Argument’ — Analyst Makes Feelings Clear on Pat McAfee’s Outrage Over Utah Controversy ESPN personality Pat McAfee has dominated the headlines this week after his spectacular rant against the University of Utah went viral. McAfee took issue with the university for posting a clip of Utah students mocking him ahead of the “College GameDay” crew’s visit to Salt Lake City for the Utes’ Week 8 clash against the Houston Cougars. After McAfee’s rant divided fans’ opinions, analyst Pete Mundo weighed in on the polarizing media personality’s outsized reaction. Analyst Stunned by Pat McAfee’s Rant Against Utah Video Clip In a recent video, Mundo sided with Utah fans over the McAfee kerfuffle and slammed the ESPN personality’s reaction to the video clip. “Pat McAfee, who I like, who I think is really good for College GameDay, who was the perfect replacement for Lee Corso, has totally lost it,” Mundo said . “And for some reason, he has lost it with Utah fans. I don’t get it, I’m not understanding it, because I’ve been a defender while many of you have not been on that McAfee train. You’ve ripped him, you’ve not been a fan, we can disagree that’s fine. “But when Pat McAfee went after Utah fans Monday after College GameDay, I’m like, ‘This can’t be real.’ Especially when I found out what he was upset about… Someone called him corny, and it’s got him all out of sorts. I promise you.” This week, McAfee followed up his rant against the University of Utah with a lengthy post on X showcasing screenshots of some of the death threats that he and his family have received. item.title: 76ers become first NBA team to strike deal with prediction market gambling company
item.description: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images 76ers become first NBA team to strike deal with prediction market gambling company appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Philadelphia 76ers have become the first NBA franchise to announce an official partnership with a prediction market company, reaching a multiyear agreement with Kalshi as the organization continues its strong start to the 2026-27 season. The Athletic’s Mike Vorkunov reported the agreement Friday on X, formerly known as Twitter, confirming that Kalshi will become Philadelphia’s official prediction market partner. “The Philadelphia 76ers have struck a multi-year deal with Kalshi to make Kalshi its official prediction market partner. Sixers say they’re the 1st NBA team to name an official prediction market partner, and are following in the footsteps of the NBA’s deals this week,” Vorkunov reported. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) The agreement represents another significant development in the NBA’s expanding relationship with prediction market platforms, which allow users to trade contracts based on the outcomes of future events, including sporting competitions. Philadelphia’s announcement follows the league’s decision earlier this week to establish partnerships with Kalshi and Polymarket, two prominent companies operating in the prediction market industry. 76ers follow NBA’s lead with historic Kalshi partnership Earlier this week, Vorkunov reported that the NBA had reached separate agreements with Kalshi and Polymarket, granting both companies access to the league’s intellectual property while establishing oversight of their available markets. “The NBA has reached deals with Kalshi and Polymarket to make them the league’s preferred prediction markets partners. The companies can now use NBA IP on their platforms, while the NBA gets right of approval on markets that they offer,” Vorkunov reported. The agreements give the NBA greater involvement in how its games, teams and other intellectual property appear on prediction market platforms. Philadelphia’s partnership also comes approximately one month after superstar LeBron James signed an ongoing endorsement agreement with Polymarket worth $15 million annually. James joined the 76ers during the offseason, becoming part of a star-studded roster featuring Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown. While James’ reported endorsement agreement involves Polymarket, Philadelphia’s organizational partnership is with Kalshi, highlighting the growing presence of competing prediction market companies throughout professional basketball. The 76ers enter Friday’s matchup against the New York Knicks with a 4-1 record , having established themselves as one of the Eastern Conference’s early contenders. Philadelphia will host the defending NBA champions, who enter the contest at 2-3, in the teams’ first NBA Cup matchup of the season. Friday’s game tips off at 7:30 p.m. ET on Prime Video. item.title: ‘We are not in Disneyland!’ - Mikel Arteta issues blunt warning to Arsenal sensation Max Dowman after red card appeal fails
item.description: Fleetwood Town v Arsenal - Carabao Cup Fourth Round - Getty Images Sport Mikel Arteta has passionately defended his harsh reaction towards Max Dowman after Arsenal's appeal against the teenager's Carabao Cup red card was dismissed. The Gunners boss insists the 16-year-old must learn the brutal realities of senior football or risk living in "Disneyland". Arsenal suffer appeal blow Arsenal's appeal against Dowman's recent red card has been officially dismissed by an independent panel . The 16-year-old was sent off during Tuesday's Carabao Cup penalty shootout defeat to Fleetwood Town after retaliating to a heavy challenge from Harrison Neal. Consequently, the record-breaking teenager will now serve a three-match suspension. Arteta expressed immediate frustration over the ruling. He admitted the club is deeply disappointed that the decision was not overturned after presenting clear evidence of provocation. Arteta demands harsh reality Arteta faced scrutiny for aggressively confronting Dowman as he left the pitch, but the Spaniard passionately defended his tough-love approach. He revealed that he had specifically warned the youngster about potential provocation from their opposition before kick-off. "I don't know. You can have a lot of reactions," Arteta insisted in a press conference. "If you see the reaction of my father and my mother with me, someday you will say, I don't like the reaction. For me, it was the best reaction ever to be able to be who I am. But you want to always see the best reaction and the beautiful one. "We are not in Disneyland. We are in the Premier League at this level and we look after him so much that you cannot imagine. But at the same time, we're going to demand him like anybody else because he needs to earn the right to play. Otherwise, the rest of the boys, what are they going to tell me? You need to be fair. Let's go." Context behind the card Dowman’s dismissal against Fleetwood marked his second red card this month, following a recent sending-off while representing England Under-19s. Despite his tender age, the teenager has already made 18 senior appearances and holds Guinness World Records as the youngest Premier League winner, goalscorer, and Champions League player. Arteta felt the panel should have considered these underlying factors, alongside the severity of the initial foul. "I think you have to read the context of the player, the age, and what happened previously," Arteta explained. "Especially with the reckless tackles that he received, and then his reaction is minimal in relation to the action. Disappointed that it's not been overturned after looking at the action back." Liverpool trip awaits Gunners With the Carabao Cup journey abruptly ended and the appeal officially dismissed, Arsenal must swiftly refocus their attention on domestic duties. item.title: Court ruling allows Russia to participate in international hockey. How does that affect the Olympics?
item.description: Olympic athletes from Russia celebrate after winning the men's gold medal hockey game against Germany, 4-3, in overtime at the 2018 Winter Olympics, Sunday, Feb. 25, 2018, in Gangneung, South Korea. (AP Photo/Jae C. Hong) | Jae C. Hong For decades, Russia has been among the top teams in international hockey — right up there with Canada, the United States and Sweden. After the country’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine, the International Ice Hockey Federation barred Russia from competing in any of the federation’s events, including the Olympics, the World Championships, the World Juniors and other significant tournaments. On Friday, the Court of Arbitration for Sport ruled that Russia must be allowed to participate in five IIHF events, effective immediately: 2027 Men’s World Championship 2027 Women’s World Championship 2027 Men’s World Junior Championship 2027 U18 Men’s World Championship 2027 U18 Women’s World Championship A major factor in the decision was the lack of evidence to support the IIHF’s security concerns, according to AP . The decision does not impact the 2030 men’s or women’s Olympic tournaments, though they are governed by the IIHF. The International Olympic Committee did, however, lift the ban on Russian athletes in July, meaning that opens the door for them to compete in the 2028 Summer Games in Los Angeles. Given the rulings of both the IOC and the CAS, it’s possible that Russian hockey players could be allowed to compete in Alpes 2030. One major concern that kept the IIHF from allowing Russia to compete was the possibility of other countries backing out in response. A number of national hockey governing bodies have released statements regarding the decision. All expressed disappointment. Finland said it will not restrict its athletes from participating, while Germany, Czechia and Austria said they will take time to make their decisions. Hockey Canada has not released an official statement, though it told Sportsnet that it is “seeking clarity” on the decision. The men’s World Junior Championship takes place in Edmonton and Red Deer, Alberta beginning Dec. 26. Similarly, the Swedish Ice Hockey Association has not released a statement, though its president, Anders Larsson, told Swedish News agency TT that “a boycott is not on the table.” As of the time of writing, USA Hockey has not released a statement. Logistical concerns The decision to permit Russia to compete in these tournaments may force the IIHF to push out a team that has already qualified. In the case of the 2027 Men’s World Championship, Ukraine was the final team to earn a spot — meaning it could be pushed out in favor of the country with which it’s at war. It also poses questions about security and international diplomacy. The CAS ruling does not have the authority to force host countries’ governments to allow Russian national teams into their countries. Some countries, including Germany, which hosts the upcoming Men’s World Championship, have voiced security concerns. Additi

item.title: Google’s satellite AI server transmits its first response to Earth

item.title: Rare meteorite from Mars gives us a view into its ancient crust
item.description: Crater counts tell us that most of the Martian surface is more than 3 billion years old, but pieces of Mars we have on Earth tell a different story. The three main classes of Martian meteorites—shergottites, nakhlites, and chassignites—are all 2.4 billion years old or younger. Until now, only two genuinely ancient Martian meteorites were known: Allan Hills 84001, found in Antarctica, and a jumbled rock from northwest Africa nicknamed Black Beauty. Now we have a third one. A team led by Yang Liu, a planetary scientist at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, has shown that a Martian meteorite called Teghaza 001, found in the Sahara Desert in Mali in 2022, formed at least 4.1 billion years ago. “It's very old and similar to some of the oldest rocks on Earth,” Liu says. A filtered collection “We don't fully understand why old Martian rocks are so rare on Earth," Liu said. Part of the answer may lie in how a piece of Mars gets here. It takes a large impact to launch a rock off the planet, and not every rock can survive that. “If the impact hits into loose powder, it may not get cemented to become a rock and fly off Mars' gravity,” Liu said. “So the natural impact already acts as a filter. Weak rocks do not make it off Mars.” Read full article Comments
